title: Watermark Word Document – Add DRAFT or CONFIDENTIAL Text
description: Add a text watermark like CONFIDENTIAL or DRAFT behind every page of a Word document, in your browser. A real Word watermark. Free, no upload.
heading: Add a watermark to Word
subtitle: Put CONFIDENTIAL, DRAFT or your own text behind every page of a Word document; nothing is uploaded.
intro: Watermark a DOCX file without Word: pick CONFIDENTIAL or DRAFT, or type your own text, choose diagonal or horizontal, a colour and a size, and download. The watermark sits behind the text on every page and is a real Word watermark in the header, so it can be removed later in Word under Design → Watermark. Documents with a different first-page header get it on the first page too. The file is changed in your browser and never uploaded.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your document is changed by your own browser and never sent to a server, so nobody else sees it.

features.title: A real Word watermark
features.text: It sits in the header like one made in Word, so it can be removed later in Word.

features.title: Your text, your look
features.text: CONFIDENTIAL, DRAFT or your own words, diagonal or horizontal, in the colour and size you choose.

stepsTitle: How to add a watermark to a Word document

steps.title: Choose your document
steps.text: Click Choose a file, or drop a .docx file on the page.

steps.title: Set the watermark
steps.text: Pick or type the text, then choose diagonal or horizontal, colour and size.

steps.title: Download
steps.text: Click Add watermark and download the Word document.

handles: Text: CONFIDENTIAL, DRAFT or your own words.
Look: diagonal or horizontal, with colour and size choices.
Pages: every page, including a first page with its own header.
limits: Text watermarks only: a picture or logo can't be used as a watermark.
The watermark is in the header, so anyone with Word can remove it under Design → Watermark.
Old .doc files can't be read; save them as .docx first.
mayNotKeep: A watermark that can't be removed

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your file is read and changed by your own browser, on your device, and is never sent anywhere. You can check it: open your browser's network panel while you use the tool and you will see no upload.

faq.question: How do I add a watermark to a Word document?
faq.answer: A Word watermark is faint text behind the text on every page, kept in the document's header; in Word it is under Design → Watermark. On this page, choose the .docx, pick CONFIDENTIAL or DRAFT or type your own text, choose its angle, colour and size, and download the document, changed in your browser.

faq.question: Can the watermark be removed later?
faq.answer: Yes. It is a real Word watermark, so it can be removed in Word under Design → Watermark.

faq.question: Can I use a logo as a watermark?
faq.answer: No. Only text watermarks are supported; pictures can't be used.

faq.question: Is the first page watermarked too?
faq.answer: Yes. Documents with a different first-page header get the watermark on the first page as well.

faq.question: Does it work with .doc files?
faq.answer: No. Old .doc files can't be read; save them as .docx in Word or LibreOffice first.
